fields.description: Extra edition of Miami Life focused on a run on Miami banks and public reaction, with commentary defending local banking stability and noting the Southern Bank & Trust Company situation. Includes local political and civic items (including references to a gubernatorial candidacy and committee activity), an editorial on motor vehicle license tags, humorous verse and satirical features, and extensive bank advertising and published condensed statements of condition for multiple South Florida banks. Also notes the death of pioneer Miamian David Afremow and includes brief local happenings and society-style columns.
